title: A famous Dua for Sustenance
data:
اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِيْ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْوَاسِعِ
ALLAAHUMMARZUQNEE MIN FAZLEKAL WAASE
O Allah, provide me out of Your all-inclusive,
الْحَلَالِ الطَّيِّبِ
AL HALAALIT TAYYEB
legal, and pleasant sustenance
رِزْقًا وَاسِعًا
RIZQAN WAASE-AA
with sustenance that is expansive,
حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا
HALAALAN TAYYEBAA
legally gotten, pleasant,
بَلَاغًا لِلدُّنْيَا وَ الْاٰخِرَةِ
BALAAGHAL LID DUNYAA WAL AAKHERAH
covering all this-worldly and other-worldly demands,
صَبًّا صَبًّا
SABBAN SABBAA
pouring, torrential,
هَنِيْئًا مَرِيْئًا
HANEE-AN MAREE-AA
enjoyable, and wholesome,
مِنْ غَيْرِ كَدٍّ
MIN GHAYRE KADDIN
without exhaustive toil,
وَ لَا مَنٍّ مِّنْ اَحَدٍ مِّنْ خَلْقِكَ
WA LAA MANNIM MIN AHADIM MIN KHALQEKA
and without the favor of any of Your creatures;
اِلَّا سَعَةً مِّنْ فَضْلِكَ الْوَاسِعِ
ILLAA SA-ATAM MIN FAZLEKAL WAASE
rather, with an abundance out of Your all-inclusive favors.
فَاِنَّكَ قُلْتَ وَاسْاَلُوا اللّٰهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ
FA-INNAKA QULTA WAS-ALUL LAAHA MIN FAZLEHI
for You have said, "Ask Allah of His grace."
فَمِنْ فَضْلِكَ اَسْاَلُ
FAMIN FAZLEKA AS-ALO
Thus, from Your grace only do I ask,
وَ مِنْ عَطِيَّتِكَ اَسْاَلُ
WA MIN ATIYYATEKA AS-ALO
from Your gift only do I ask,
وَ مِنْ يَدِكَ الْمَلْاٰ اَسْاَلُ
WA MIN YADEKAL MALAA AS-ALO
and from Your abounding hand do I ask.
merits: Mu'awiyah ibn 'Ammar reported: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) to teach me a supplication for more sustenance. He taught me this supplication, which I have never seen anything more effective than.
